name: Astral Palm
description: Strike with a palm lit by a fixed point of astral light that pricks through the guard.

name: Astral Guard
description: Hold a thin plane of astral light before the body that scatters a blow into sparks.

name: Astral Stride
description: Take a long gliding stride along a line of astral light and settle at the end without a jolt.

name: Astral Turn
description: Turn a strike along an arc of astral light so it passes harmlessly round the body.

name: Astral Chart
description: Chart every foe in reach as a bright point and read from the chart who will move and who is weak.

name: Chart Strike
description: Strike along the line the chart shows between two points in the foe and drive qi through both.

name: Astral Mend
description: Rest a steady astral light on a wound and let it draw the torn flesh together in yourself or an ally.

name: Astral Volley
description: Loose a volley of star-bright bolts from the charted points that strike the foe together.

name: Astral Mantle
description: Settle a mantle of astral light over yourself and the allies at your side that dims the force of heavy blows.

name: Quasar Palm
description: Strike with a palm that carries a searing point of qi from the quasar at the heart of the field.

name: Quasar Guard
description: Close the quasar's glow round the forearms in a hard shell that rings under a blow.

name: Quasar Step
description: Fire off the back foot on a jet of qi from the heart and land well past the foe's reach.

name: Quasar Turn
description: Let a strike run along the bright rim of the guard and throw it off in a fan of light.

name: Quasar Draw
description: Feed the quasar at the heart a long breath until the limbs hum with stored brightness.

name: Quasar Reading
description: Let the light of the heart spread out through the field and mark every qi that dims it.

name: Quasar Jet
description: Throw a narrow jet of bright qi from the palm that punches through a guard and the arm behind it.

name: Quasar Dazzle
description: Flash the quasar's full brightness into the foe's eyes so he strikes at a blur.

name: Quasar Mend
description: Pour a steady warmth of bright qi into a deep hurt and close it in yourself or an ally.

name: Quasar Beam
description: Gather the heart's light into one thin brilliant beam and loose it through whatever stands in line.

name: Quasar Surge
description: Pour the overflow of the quasar into an ally so his limbs burn bright with strength for a long span.

name: Nebula Palm
description: Strike with a palm wreathed in a glowing mist of starlit qi that clings to the target.

name: Nebula Guard
description: Wrap the body in a soft glowing mist that swallows the force of a blow.

name: Nebula Step
description: Step through a trailing mist of starlight that hides the true path of the feet.

name: Nebula Turn
description: Turn a strike into the glowing mist where it loses its line and slides away.

name: Misted Veil
description: Drape a veil of starlit mist over the foe's sight so the body seems to stand where it does not.

name: Nebula Dart
description: Flick a dart of condensed starlit mist from the fingertips that stings where it hits.

name: Starveil
description: Draw a deep veil of starlight round yourself that hides the form and turns aside blows from every side.

name: Nebula Burst
description: Burst the veil outward in a roll of bright mist that strikes every foe close about you.

name: Parallax Palm
description: Strike with a palm that seems to stand a hand's width from where it lands.

name: Parallax Shroud
description: Hold the guard a little off from where the eye puts it so a blow lands on empty air.

name: Parallax Stride
description: Shift the body a hand's width off the line the foe saw and strike from the new place.

name: Parallax Turn
description: Take a blow on the forearm that was never quite where the foe aimed and turn it by.

name: Parallax Reading
description: Look at a foe from two points in the field at once to learn his true range and height.

name: Shifted Blow
description: Throw a strike the foe sees at one angle that lands from another and passes his guard.

name: Feigned Bearing
description: Give the foe a false bearing on your position so his best strike falls on air.

name: Parallax Mend
description: Draw a wound back into line with a steady star-bright press in yourself or an ally.

name: Parallax Break
description: Split the foe's sight in two and drive a single piercing blow through the gap between the images.

name: Parallax Screen
description: Hold a shifted image of yourself before the foe so every attack lands a hand's width astray.

name: Azimuth Palm
description: Fix the bearing on the foe and strike straight down it with a star-bright palm.

name: Azimuth Guard
description: Turn the guard to the exact bearing of the blow and meet it face on with bright qi.

name: Azimuth Step
description: Step round the foe through a set angle and end exactly on the bearing you meant.

name: Azimuth Turn
description: Rotate the guard by a few degrees and turn a heavy blow clean off its line.

name: Azimuth Fix
description: Fix the bearing of every foe about you by starlight and keep it fixed as they move.

name: Azimuth Strike
description: Strike along a fixed bearing so exactly that the blow lands on the weakest point of the guard.

name: Compass Mend
description: Point a finger of starlight along the line of a wound and close it from end to end.

name: Azimuth Volley
description: Loose bolts of starlight along the fixed bearing so all arrive on the same point.

name: Azimuth Sweep
description: Sweep a bright arm of qi round the whole circle of bearings and strike every foe on it.

name: Ecliptic Palm
description: Strike along the long curve of the stance so the palm lands with the whole sweep behind it.

name: Ecliptic Guard
description: Draw a long curve of starlit qi before the body that a blow cannot meet squarely.

name: Ecliptic Step
description: Travel round the foe along a long smooth curve without any break in the stride.

name: Ecliptic Turn
description: Carry a blow along the guard's long curve until it has spent itself beyond the shoulder.

name: Ecliptic Draw
description: Draw the qi along the slow curve of the whole body and let it gather strength as it goes.

name: Ecliptic Reading
description: Follow the path the foe's qi takes across his body and tell where it will end.

name: Ecliptic Cut
description: Cut across the foe on one long arc of bright qi that opens the guard along its whole length.

name: Ecliptic Hold
description: Draw a bright ring about the foe's limbs along the curve and tighten it until he cannot raise an arm.

name: Ecliptic Mend
description: Trace the slow curve of starlight round an injury to ease the pain and knit the hurt for an ally.

name: Ecliptic Cleanse
description: Wash a steady curve of starlight through the blood to carry a poison or a taint out of yourself or an ally.

name: Long Ecliptic
description: Draw the long path of starlight across the whole field and strike every foe it crosses at once.

name: Ecliptic Mantle
description: Wrap yourself in the long curve of the path so blows from any side slide round and fail.
